caption: Per-clash deployment distance: the battle opens at a 60 m line gap instead of the default 29 m (the same Battle.deployment_gap_m a campaign clash sets from its defended province's deployment_gap_m), with the field grown downward so the defenders keep their ground behind the line. Both armies start beyond the demote range as far-tier grid marks; the player's archers and right-centre cavalry are box-selected at tick 20 and marched down the open lane between the forest and the hill while the enemy advances, both sides promote back to individual soldiers as the gap closes inside 20 m, and they clash.
